card.name: Stock ticker and investment disclosure text
card.fires_on: Words inside company stock-listing phrases, such as the ticker letters after 'traded as' or 'stock symbol', and in author investment disclosures about holding a position in a company.

modes.label: Ticker symbols
modes.description: Letters of a ticker or the words 'stock symbol' when a company's listing is given.

modes.label: Investment disclosure
modes.description: Words in a disclosure saying the author has no position in a company.
